task.title: To create a Switch Connection action

step.cmd: Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Switch Connections. The Switch Connections Action window opens.
Type a name in the Action Name field.

info.p: This name displays on the X-Author Designer. For example, this is the name you will see when you design your action flows.

step.cmd: Type a name in the Switch Connection Name.

info.p: This name displays to the runtime user and should be used to prompt the user to enter the correct connection information.

postreq.p: You can now add the Switch Connection action to your Action Flows.
